139	**Daylight — resolve the Decree:** Craft using roosts first, then resolve **every Decree card**, column by column **Recruit → Move → Battle → Build**. Within one column choose card order freely. Bird is wild. **If any required action cannot be fully completed, immediately enter Turmoil: you cannot skip the card or continue other columns.** For a prompted placement with too few pieces, first place the maximum possible, then enter Turmoil because the action remains incomplete (publisher clarification in **FAQ & Rulings**). Each card requires:

   141	| Decree column | Match the card's suit to | Required procedure for one card |
   142	|---|---|---|
   143	| Recruit | Clearing with a roost | Place **one warrior at one chosen roost** there; Charismatic must instead place **two warriors** there |
   144	| Move | Origin clearing | Move **at least one warrior**, obeying ordinary path and rule requirements |
   145	| Battle | Clearing of battle | Initiate a battle there with Eyrie warriors and an enemy |
   146	| Build | Target clearing | Place one roost in a clearing you rule, with an open slot and **no roost already there** |
   147	
   148	**Bird Decree cards are wild in every column:** choose any clearing suit, while still meeting that action’s other requirements.
   149	
   150	If a prompted placement runs short, place the maximum possible first, as clarified in **FAQ & Rulings**. If the required action cannot be completed fully for any reason (including warrior/building supply), immediately enter **Turmoil**; do not skip that card or continue other Decree columns. With Charismatic and only one warrior available, place that one, then enter Turmoil: one does not fulfill the required two.
   151	
   152	**Turmoil, in order:** Lose one VP per bird Decree card **including both Loyal Viziers**; discard every Decree card except Viziers; flip current leader face down and choose a face-up replacement. If none face up, flip all leaders face up before choosing. Retuck Viziers in new leader's columns. End Daylight and proceed to the full normal Evening: **score the roost track, draw one plus uncovered bonuses, then discard to five**. **Turmoil does not remove your map warriors or buildings.**
   153	
   154	**Evening, even after turmoil:** Score the VP on rightmost empty roost-track space. Draw one plus uncovered draw bonuses; discard down to five.
   155

   157	|---|---|---|
   158	| Builder | Recruit, Move | Ignore Disdain for Trade |
   159	| Charismatic | Recruit, Battle | Each Recruit must place two warriors instead of one |
   160	| Commander | Move, Battle | One extra hit as attacker |
   161	| Despot | Move, Build | When removing at least one enemy building/token in battle, score one extra VP in addition to normal removal points |
   164	
   165	**Guerrilla War:** When Alliance defends, Alliance uses higher die and attacker lower; warrior caps still apply. **Supporters** are a separate face-down stack, inspectable by Alliance. They can be spent only for suit; they do not count as hand cards or toward hand limit. With no bases on map, maximum **five supporters**; incoming cards beyond capacity are discarded. With any base, unlimited supporters.
   166	
   167	**Outrage:** Each time another player **removes sympathy** or **moves any warriors into a sympathetic clearing**, that player adds one matching hand card (birds count) to Supporters. Moving a group costs one card per affected move, rather than one per warrior. If no matching cards including birds, show hand to Alliance, then Alliance draws one deck card into Supporters. **If Supporters is full, discard the incoming Outrage card; payment or the no-match draw still occurs.** Merely battling there is no trigger unless sympathy is removed; placing warriors there and moving only Vagabond pawn do not trigger it.
   168	
   169	**Losing a base:** Discard all supporters matching its clearing **including birds**, remove half officers **rounded up**. If no bases remain, discard excess supporters down to five. Do this whenever a base is removed.
   170	
   171	**Birdsong:** Both Revolt and Spread Sympathy take place **during Birdsong**. Complete **all Revolts before starting any Spread Sympathy**; each may be performed any number of times. **For both actions, every supporter spent must match the target clearing; birds are wild.** Once spreading starts, you cannot return to Revolt this Birdsong, so newly spread sympathy cannot support a same-Birdsong Revolt:
   172	
   173	- **Revolt:** Choose sympathetic clearing without a base, matching a base still on your board. Spend **two matching supporters**. **Remove all enemy pieces there and score one VP per enemy building/token removed**; then place matching base. Place warriors there equal to number of sympathetic clearings matching the base's printed suit (including revolt clearing), and one warrior in Officers box. Score normal VP for removed enemy buildings/tokens. Resolve the effect even if a prompted placement cannot be completed: place the maximum possible, without adding a base-placement prerequisite. Enemy Vagabond damages three items instead of being removed.
   174	- **Spread Sympathy:** Choose unsympathetic clearing adjacent by path to sympathy; if no sympathy anywhere, choose any clearing. Spend matching supporters shown above next sympathy token. **Martial Law:** add one matching supporter if chosen clearing has at least three warriors of **one other player**. Place token and score uncovered space. Only one sympathy per clearing. Keep's placement ban still applies.
   175	
   176	**Daylight:** Any order and number:
   177	
   178	- **Craft** from hand with sympathy.
   179	- **Mobilize:** Add one hand card to Supporters. With no base on map, keep at most five supporters and discard incoming overflow; with any base, the stack has no cap.
   180	- **Train during Daylight:** Spend a **hand card** matching a clearing with a base to place one supply warrior in Officers box. Supporters cannot pay Train. Each officer allows one Evening military operation; taking operations does not consume officers.
   181	
   182	**Evening:** The four military operations are **Move, Battle, Recruit and Organize**. Take **up to your number of officers** in operations, in any order and repetition. Officers stay on the board; taking an operation does not consume an officer. After operations, draw one card plus one per uncovered draw bonus, then discard hand down to five.

   184	| Military operation | Procedure for one operation |
   185	|---|---|
   186	| Move | Take one move using normal movement rules |
   187	| Battle | Initiate one battle |
   188	| Recruit | Place one warrior at one clearing with a base |
   189	| Organize | Remove one Alliance warrior from an unsympathetic clearing; place sympathy there; score the uncovered VP |

   191	Organize spends no supporters and has no sympathy-adjacency requirement or Martial Law cost; it still needs legal token placement. **After operations**, draw one card plus one per uncovered draw bonus, then discard hand down to five.

   193	### Vagabond (9; V.1–3)
   194	
   195	**Pawn and items:** Pawn is not a warrior, cannot rule or block rule, and cannot be removed. An enemy effect removing **all enemy pieces** from its clearing instead damages **three items**. Items may be face up (ready) or face down (exhausted), and independently undamaged or damaged. To exhaust for an action, choose a face-up **undamaged** item and flip it down. Damaged items cannot pay actions.
   196	
   197	Face-up tea/coins/bags in Satchel immediately move to empty matching track space if possible; each track holds at most three of its type. Exhausting an item on track sends it to Satchel. Boots/swords/crossbows/torch/hammers are gained face up in Satchel. Damaging an item sends it to Damaged box **without changing its face**. One hit damages one undamaged item of your choice; ignore excess hits when none remain.
   198	
   199	**Birdsong:**
   200	
   201	1. **Refresh:** First count tea **already face up on Refresh track**; flip two exhausted items face up per counted tea, then three more exhausted items. Tea refreshed during this step gives no extra refresh this step. Refreshing changes face, not damaged status.
   202	2. **Slip (optional):** Move to an adjacent clearing or forest, exhausting **no boots**, even into hostile warriors. Ignore all effects preventing movement **out of** a clearing. **Forest adjacency for Slip:** a forest is adjacent to clearings touching it without crossing a printed path, and to forests separated by one printed path. On Winter, the river also divides forests as paths do.
   203	
   204	**Daylight:** Any order/number, as ready undamaged items permit:
   205	
   206	- **Move:** Exhaust one boot, plus **one extra boot** if destination has any warriors of any Hostile faction (also for forced moves). Ignore rule. **Cannot enter a forest with this action; from a forest you may move only to an adjacent clearing.** Slip has the special free-boot exception.
   207	- **Battle:** Exhaust one sword to initiate. Maximum rolled hits, attacking or defending, equals **all undamaged swords in Satchel, face up or face down**. As defender you are defenseless only with no undamaged swords. Take hits as item damage.
   208	- **Explore:** Exhaust torch in ruin's clearing. Take one hidden item face up into Satchel or track; score one VP if an item taken. Remove ruin when its last item is taken, freeing the building slot.
   209	- **Aid:** Exhaust **one face-up, undamaged item of any type**, give a card matching your clearing to player with faction pieces there, even Hostile. May then take one item from their Crafted Items box face up into Satchel/track; no available item is required to Aid. **Only non-Hostile relationships can advance through Aid; a Hostile recipient stays Hostile.** Check relationship improvement below.
   210	- **Quest (matching clearing only):** Choose a face-up quest matching clearing; exhaust its **two listed items**, put quest in play area completed. Choose either VP equal to matching completed quests **including this one**, or draw two cards. Draw replacement quest into public display. No cards are spent to pay a quest.
   211	- **Strike:** Exhaust crossbow to remove one enemy warrior in clearing. Only if that enemy has no warriors there may you remove another of its faction pieces instead. Check hostility. Strike is not battle and gives no Infamy.
   212	- **Repair:** Exhaust hammer; move one damaged item to Satchel **keeping current face**. Ready tea/coins/bags move to tracks if space.
   213	- **Craft:** Exhaust one hammer per crafting icon; pawn acts as crafting piece matching current clearing, and may activate repeatedly despite normal once-per-turn crafting limit. Clearing must match **all icons**; cannot craft mixed fox/rabbit/mouse requirements from one clearing. When you craft an item, you may immediately take that item face up into Satchel/track and **use it for another Daylight action immediately**, if its cost and other requirements are met. Need supply item as usual.
   214	- **Special:** Exhaust items required by character action below.
   215	
   216	**Relationships:** Each other faction starts Indifferent. To advance a non-Hostile marker one space, Aid that faction as many times **in this same turn** as printed between current and next spaces. One Aid counts toward only one improvement. Advance and score VP printed in new space. At final space become **Allied**; each subsequent Aid to that faction scores **two VP**.
   217	
   218	**Allied benefits:** Aid gains two VP, warriors may accompany movement, and participating warriors increase the attacking rolled-hit limit as follows:
   219	
   220	- **Aid:** Each subsequent Aid to this Allied faction scores **two VP**.
   221	- **Move:** May force warriors of **one** Allied faction to accompany the pawn to its destination clearing. They follow their own movement restrictions, including rule and Eyrie tie advantage. They cannot accompany a move specified to be alone. Apply the forced-movement Outrage clarification in **FAQ & Rulings**: Allied Alliance warriors do not trigger their own Outrage; another Allied faction's warriors do.
   222	- **Attack with an increased hit limit:** At the start of battle **as attacker**, you may treat warriors of **one** Allied faction in the battle clearing as your own. **Add those warriors to all your undamaged swords to determine your maximum rolled hits**. They can join against a different enemy; you cannot use an ally's warriors to attack that ally itself.
   223	
   224	**Taking hits with an ally:** In a battle using Allied warriors as your own, you may absorb hits by removing those warriors or damaging your items. If you remove **more allied warriors than items you damage in that battle**, the ally becomes Hostile **at battle end**. This overrides ordinary hostility timing for those friendly warriors taken as hits against the other enemy. Equal numbers do not trigger the rule.
   225	
   226	- **Hostile:** Removing **one** warrior of a non-Hostile faction immediately moves marker to Hostile (except allied battle-loss rule above). **Infamy:** During battle on your own turn, score **one extra VP per hostile piece removed**, except warrior that first made faction Hostile. **Each hostile building/token removed in battle on your turn normally scores two VP: one removal VP plus one Infamy. A hostile warrior scores one Infamy, except the warrior that first caused Hostile status.** Infamy depends on whose turn it is, rather than which side attacks: no Infamy on another player's turn, and none from Strike. Hostile status requires extra boot for moves into hostile warriors, not merely buildings/tokens.
   227	- Aid cannot move marker out of Hostile; it can still obtain a crafted item. Coalition with Hostile faction resets its marker to Indifferent.
   228	
   229	**Evening, all four steps:**
   230	
   231	1. If in forest, **Rest**: return all damaged items to Satchel and flip them face up; ready tea/coins/bags move to tracks if able. This does not refresh undamaged exhausted items.
   232	2. **Always draw**, even after forest Rest: one card plus one per face-up coins on track.
   233	3. Discard hand to five.
   234	4. **Capacity, the last step of Evening after drawing and discarding:** Satchel **plus Damaged box** may contain **six items plus two per face-up bag on its track**. Track items do not count toward load. Permanently remove chosen Satchel/Damaged items until within limit. Do not check capacity immediately upon acquiring an item.

   236	| Base character | Starting items | Special action |
   237	|---|---|---|
   238	| Thief | boot, torch, tea, sword | **Steal:** exhaust torch to take random hand card from player with faction pieces in your clearing |
   239	| Tinker | boot, torch, bag, hammer | **Day Labor:** exhaust torch to take discard-pile card matching clearing; bird always qualifies |
   240	| Ranger | boot, torch, crossbow, sword | **Hideout:** exhaust torch to repair three items, keeping their faces; immediately end Daylight and begin Evening |
   241	
   254	Faction/card scoring can add to these ordinary points. In particular, Vagabond Infamy is an **additional** point per eligible Hostile piece in battle on his own turn, except the warrior that first caused Hostile status. Do not add an ordinary removal point for a warrior.
   255	
   256	**Dominance (3.3):** In own Daylight at **at least 10 VP**, activate a dominance card from hand into play area; remove score marker and stop scoring VP. Cannot remove/replace activated card. At **start of own Birdsong**, win if ruling **three clearings of matching mouse/rabbit/fox suit**, or for **bird dominance, two diagonally opposite corner clearings**. Meeting condition earlier does not immediately win. Dominance cards cannot be crafted, but can be spent for suit. Whenever one would enter discard, put it near map available instead. During own Daylight, spend matching card to take available dominance into hand. Available **bird dominance remains bird**, so payment must be bird; a bird hand card can pay for non-bird dominance. Activation and taking are separate, neither requires a faction action allowance.
   257	
   258	**Vagabond coalition (9.2.8):** Cannot activate normal dominance win. With **four or more players**, during own Daylight at **at least 10 VP**, activate dominance to coalition with another player **not already in coalition**, whose VP is lowest among players other than you (choose among ties). **An already-activated dominance player cannot be chosen:** they have no score marker on the track (publisher clarification in **FAQ & Rulings**). Compare eligible players still on the score track. Put your score marker on partner's faction board and stop scoring. If partner wins, you also win, including if partner later activates and wins through dominance. Coalition partners are not enemies. A Hostile partner becomes Indifferent. Coalition does not by itself grant Allied relationship powers.
